receipt.decision-statuses.fully-underwri: QuickDecision is not currently available for this product. Your application will continue through the standard review process, and you'll be contacted if additional information is needed or when a decision is available.
receipt.decision-statuses.conditionally-: Congratulations! Based upon the information provided and our verification with vendors, you have been conditionally approved. Your group plan administrator needs to review your application to confirm your eligibility for this product. You will be sent details about your coverage once this is completed, typically within just a few days.
receipt.decision-statuses.referred.label: Sent for review
receipt.decision-statuses.referred.descr: We will review your details and be in touch soon. Based upon your responses and information from background databases about you, a representative may need to call you to verify your medical details in order to process your application. You will be sent details about your coverage request once this is completed.
Based on the medical or other history you provided and/or information from databases about you, we are unable to approve your request for coverage. Please download your completed application for your records. You may contact the Plan Administrator if you have questions about this decision or other coverage options.
receipt.decision-statuses.database-unava: One of the databases we use to verify background information did not respond to our request in time. This is typically a result of scheduled maintenance. Our team will contact the vendor within the next business day to complete your application processing. If additional information is needed from you, a representative will call you within just a few days. Otherwise, you will be sent details about your coverage request once our confirmation is complete.
receipt.documents-note: Your confirmation email includes a summary of your request and coverage decisions. Please download your documentation now using the links below. Application and payment documents are not included in the email.
